profiles.description:
Quanta is a systematic strategy engine for tokenized equities on Robinhood Chain. Instead of hand-picking stocks, users choose a transparent rule such as momentum, low volatility, risk parity, or factor tilt, then test it against available onchain history.

Every strategy is built around visible parameters, historical data, liquidity constraints, and reproducible results. When deployed, the strategy is designed to operate through a keyless vault with defined limits on execution, slippage, venues, and rebalancing.

Quanta is for people who want a portfolio process they can inspect, rerun, and understand before they commit to it.

A meme coin on Robinhood chain. Nobody knows what he is. He looks funny.

Roo is a small fuzzy thing with pale green skin, a beard, stick legs and hair that points straight up. Nobody knows what he is, including the people who made this coin. He looks funny. That is the whole coin.
